content.text: Blue Moon is a two-player German expandable card game by Reiner Knizia, published by Kosmos and Fantasy Flight Games, in which fantasy factions duel with asymmetric decks.
Published in 2004, Blue Moon was later classified by Fantasy Flight Games within the living card game style of fixed-expansion card games rather than randomized boosters.
2 players use the table arrangement described for Blue Moon.
Commercial Blue Moon expandable card decks; 344-card product line with faction decks
Commercial Blue Moon expandable card decks; 344-card product line with faction decks, score area, and enough table space for play.
